chapter.title: The heart
chapter.story: He died in Ilmara with no notebook and no money, and asked only that his pages be given back to the people.

pages.saying: The strong man is not the one who wrestles others down; he is the one who controls himself when angry.
pages.idris: Khattab shouted and you stayed calm. That was strength.
pages.found: Faris found a page lining an old hat bought from a pedlar.

pages.saying: I guarantee a house on the edge of Paradise for whoever gives up arguing even when he is right.
pages.idris: Even when you're right. Especially then.
pages.found: Salma hands you a loaf wrapped in an old page. “Look at the writing on this.”

pages.saying: The best of you are those with the best character.
pages.idris: Not the richest, not the cleverest. The kindest.
pages.found: Rashid found a folded page in a crack while mending a wall. “It's in a scholar's hand. You'll know who wants it.”

pages.saying: What brings people into Paradise most is fear of Allah and good character.
pages.idris: Two things. Both of them in your hands.
pages.found: Children are flying a kite made from an old page. Layla buys it from them for a date and gives it to you.

pages.saying: Do not think little of any kindness, even meeting your brother with a cheerful face.
pages.idris: Smile at Rashid tomorrow. It counts.
pages.found: Jamal found a page pressed inside a second-hand book.

pages.saying: A man asked who most deserves his good company. Your mother, he was told - three times - then your father.
pages.idris: Write to your mother, traveller. Tonight.
pages.found: Abbas has been using a page to wrap spices and has only just noticed the writing.

pages.saying: Fear Allah and be fair between your children.
pages.idris: Fairness starts at home before it reaches the market.
pages.found: Karim pulls a damp page from the bottom of a basket and dries it for you.

pages.saying: Whoever has wronged his brother should put it right today, before a day when there is no money, only deeds.
pages.idris: If there's someone you wronged on your road, go back to them. Today.
pages.found: The innkeeper found a page under a loose floor tile.

pages.saying: Say Allah's name, eat with your right hand, and eat from what is in front of you.
pages.idris: The last lesson is the smallest - how to eat. Even that is worship.
pages.found: Yunus the muezzin was given a debt note - and the scholar's page is written on the back of it.
